name: Griddo AX Docs
description:
Griddo Docs gives Claude the official documentation of the Griddo backoffice (Author Experience), the DXP designed exclusively for universities. Ask how to do something in Griddo and Claude answers with what the documentation says, linking the exact page on docs.griddo.io.

What Claude can do with it
• Search the documentation in Spanish or English and get ranked excerpts, each with the canonical URL of its page.
• Read a full page when an excerpt is not enough to answer accurately.
• List every page by section to see what the documentation covers.

Why the answers hold up
• Same content as docs.griddo.io, published from the same build and updated with every release of the documentation.
• Griddo's real concepts: modules, templates, content types, data packs, roles and publishing.
• Every answer can cite its source page.

Who it is for
Content authors, editors and site administrators who work in Griddo: university web, marketing, admissions and communications teams. Public and read-only. Set it up once and it is ready to use; the connector receives only your search terms and the paths of the pages it reads.

Scope
It covers the backoffice, the tool content teams use every day. Developer topics (@griddo/core, schemas, module code, API, SDK) are out of scope for this connector.

Try asking
• "How do I add an image to a page?"
• "How do I share a draft for review?"
• "Which roles can edit a site's forms?"
• "How do I restrict who can edit a page?"

_published_faq.name: How do I add Griddo AX Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Griddo AX Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ax.mcp.griddo.io/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Griddo AX Docs MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Griddo AX Docs scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Griddo AX Docs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Griddo AX Docs provides these MCP tools: get_griddo_editor_doc, list_griddo_editor_docs, and search_griddo_editor_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Griddo AX Docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Griddo AX Docs in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, Tolt, and Affitor.

_published_faq.name: Does Griddo AX Docs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Griddo AX Docs does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Griddo AX Docs is developed by Griddo Digital. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
